In accordance with the Companies Act, 2013, the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020, the Information Technology Act, 2000, and the Digital Personal Data Protection (DPDP) Act, 2023, this page details the corporate identity, statutory registrations, legal metrology details, and grievance redressal contacts for Saint Roman Private Limited.

1. Corporate identification & registered office

Saint Roman operates as a legally registered private limited company incorporated under the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA), Government of India.

  • Full Registered Name: Annoria House of Brands Private Limited
  • Corporate Identification Number (CIN): U14109KA2026PTC225933
  • Taxpayer Registration (GSTIN): [Insert 15-Digit GST Number, e.g., 29AAAAA0000A1Z5]
  • Permanent Account Number (PAN): ABGCA4379N
  • Date of Incorporation: 11/08/2026
  • Registered Office Address: Annoria House of Brands Private Limited, 5, 8th B Cross, Tent Road, Sanjeevani Nagar, Nagarbhavi, Bangalore North, Bangalore — 560072, Karnataka
  • Corporate Headquarters: Annoria House of Brands Private Limited, [Insert Office / Tech Park Address], [Insert City, State, PIN Code], India
  • Official Website: www.saintromanfashion.com

2. Legal metrology & brand compliance

In compliance with the Legal Metrology (Packaged Commodities) Rules, 2011, all products manufactured, packaged, and retailed by Saint Roman across digital storefronts and physical channels carry transparent consumer declarations:

  • Manufacturer & Marketer Details: Every product package lists Saint Roman Private Limited as the brand owner and marketer, alongside the exact manufacturing/importing unit address.
  • MRP Declarations: Prices listed across all product detail pages (PDPs), price tags, and physical multi-pack boxes are Maximum Retail Prices (MRP) inclusive of all applicable statutory taxes (GST).
  • Net Quantity & Country of Origin: All product listings and physical packaging clearly disclose the net quantity of goods enclosed (e.g., Pack of 3 Trunks, 1 N Bra) and explicitly declare the Country of Origin: India.
  • Fiber & Fabric Disclosures: In compliance with Textile Labelling Standards, fabric composition (e.g., 95% Micro-Modal, 5% Elastane) is explicitly stated on product pages and physical garment wash-care labels.

3. Statutory grievance redressal mechanism

In accordance with Rule 5(9) of the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules, 2020 and Section 5 of the Information Technology (Intermediary Guidelines and Digital Media Ethics Code) Rules, 2021, Saint Roman has appointed a dedicated Grievance Officer to ensure prompt resolution of consumer complaints, data privacy requests, and legal notices.

  • Designated Officer: Head of Legal, Regulatory & Compliance
  • Company Name: Saint Roman Private Limited
  • Postal Address for Legal Notices: Attn: Grievance Officer, Legal Department, Annoria House of Brands Private Limited, 5, 8th B Cross, Tent Road, Sanjeevani Nagar, Nagarbhavi, Bangalore North, Bangalore — 560072, Karnataka
  • Direct Compliance E-mail: grievance@saintromanfashion.com / legal@saintromanfashion.com
  • Dedicated Nodal Helpline: +91-[Insert Dedicated Support Number]
  • Grievance Desk Hours: Monday through Friday, 10:00 AM to 6:00 PM IST (excluding Public Holidays)

Grievance Handling Protocol & SLAs:

  • Acknowledgment SLA: The Grievance Officer shall acknowledge receipt of any consumer complaint, legal notice, or statutory query within 48 hours of receipt.
  • Resolution SLA: The Grievance Officer shall investigate and resolve the complaint within 30 days from the date of receipt, issuing a formal written resolution ticket to the complainant.

4. Intellectual property & trademark declaration

  • Registered Trademarks: The word mark "SAINT ROMAN", the visual brand logos, tagline assets, and custom packaging designs are the exclusive intellectual property of Annoria House of Brands Private Limited, protected under the Trade Marks Act, 1999 and Copyright Act, 1957.
  • Proprietary Software & App Interface: The design, source code, soft-touch UI components, and software architectures of www.saintromanfashion.com and the Saint Roman Mobile Application are protected under Indian copyright law. Unauthorised copying, scraping, reverse-engineering, or commercial use without prior written consent is strictly prohibited and subject to legal prosecution.

5. Regulatory nodal contact for authorities

For law enforcement agencies, cybercrime divisions, or government bodies seeking statutory information or issuing official orders under Indian jurisdiction:

  • Nodal Officer Contact: nodal@saintromanfashion.com / legal@saintromanfashion.com
  • Response Window: Official law enforcement notices are acknowledged and acted upon within timelines prescribed under the IT Rules, 2021.
